blocking.issue: Regression from the L2-6 fix. The rewrite adds `--environments` to validate and build, but it drops 'to an OCI registry' from `ruralz bundle push` and gives push no flags. The CLI and API surface table makes `--env` required for push. Without `--oci REFERENCE`, push sends the source Bundle to Ruralz Control, and RA-1 has no Ruralz Control. Push is also a Bundle reader, so with no Ruralz Control it needs `--environments` for `--env` to resolve (Configuration model, Environment substitution). As written, the RA-1 publish step fails, so file-mode Nodes never get a signed Revision to pull.
